name: Galium

project_scope.note: Genus lesson only; native-range states unchanged.

shared_genus_recognition.look_here_first: Count the leaflike units at a mature stem node, then inspect stem-edge prickles and flowering shoot length.
traits: Small herbaceous Rubiaceae with four-angled stems and apparent whorls of leaflike organs; two units are enlarged stipules.
Tiny four-lobed flowers and paired one-seeded dry mericarps.
All three may have hooked fruit bristles; fruit hooks alone do not identify G. aparine.

species_comparison_matrix.Galium virgatum: 1–2 flowers close to node, later short leafy cyme

species_comparison_matrix.photo_role: Three-way burr macro; mark shared trait

field_steps: Count several mid-stem whorls: 6–8 plus retrorse stem hooks suggests G. aparine; four suggests G. texense or G. virgatum.
For four-unit whorls, compare ovate broad blades and longer cymes (texense) versus narrow blades, pale underside structures and short node-bound flowers (virgatum).
Check flowers and mature fruit with a millimeter scale; stop at Galium sp. when characters disagree.
overlap_cautions: Fruit hooks are shared, not an exclusive cleavers character.
G. texense and G. virgatum fruit sizes overlap; use several characters.
Mature whorl counts and stem armature are more reliable than habit or flower color.
Leaflike stipules must not all be labeled true leaves.
This is not a county-native certification or a species-install action.

local_source_pool_lookalikes.difference: Look for a persistent toothed calyx and funnel-shaped corolla, unlike the tiny rotate Galium flower.
Opposite leaves and distinct stipules, not Galium's apparent multi-membered whorls.
Woody shrub with spherical flower heads rather than weak-stemmed herb with axillary cymes.

diagnostic_photo_checklist.target: Count and label true leaves plus leaflike stipules
Show backward hooks versus straight bristles with arrows

diagnostic_photo_checklist.role: G. texense versus G. virgatum blades
diagnostic_photo_checklist.target: Show mature blade widths and abaxial raised structures with scale
Compare long axillary cyme with short leafy dwarf shoot
Show measured mericarps and shared hooked bristles
